parameters.query:
SELECT 
    mod.definition AS dev_definition_latest
FROM 
    sys.procedures AS p
INNER JOIN 
    sys.sql_modules AS mod ON mod.object_id = p.object_id
INNER JOIN 
    sys.schemas AS sch ON sch.schema_id = p.schema_id
WHERE 
    sch.name + '.' + p.name = '{{ $json.procedure_name }}';
